## Accepted execution contract v3 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is10000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. The prior1000-read blocks remain retained and unaccepted; longer-exposure/key-coverage decision: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6039866047. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal and primary output

Produce the final integrated **artifact/report PR** for [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090) on frozen merged product and [#5096](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5096) harness identities. Demonstrate the parent's substantial public read/native-mutation gains, publication memory resolution and bounded reclamation economics. Correctness alone or merged children does not close this packet.

Dependencies require merged [#5096](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5096) plus all activated runtime/shared prerequisites and accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) target decisions. No runtime or harness edits belong in the artifact-only descendant; changed runtime/schema invalidates the affected freeze and goes back to its owner before recollection.

## Collection and report

Use a verified high-capacity Linux runner with persistent build cache and durable artifact storage. Record actual shared-host activity and run interleaved baseline/candidate fresh-process controls; absolute quiet is not required. Infrastructure absence is typed `INFRASTRUCTURE_UNAVAILABLE: runner|cache|storage: reason` plus actual fallback. Preserve raw noisy/rejected/failing attempts and original source/build/binary identities.

Execute the landed protocol across selected population, asset/revision, concurrency and row-width/index/mutation shapes. Do not silently omit the expensive/cold/ordinary route or unsupported classification. Current-only runs, Go-only SQLite memory comparison, overlapping nested timers, five-epoch plateau extrapolation and fewer semantic obligations cannot prove an optimization.

Report each north-star/exit/guardrail/observational metric with baseline/candidate, deltas, repetition/noise classification, exact commands and effective environment. Attribute remaining request CPU/sync/wait, setup/retention, checkpoint allocations, physical bytes/rotation and deferred/protected maintenance. Record which optimized/fallback public paths ran. Full current/historical postings, held views, input/output ownership, crash/reopen and affected modeled-power-loss evidence must bind the claimed product.

## Acceptance and failure action

- [ ] Complete public GetInto/ordinary-range read objectives and structural executor/output work gates pass.
- [ ] Equivalent native indexed updates remove old full-row round trips/unchanged-asset work and meet processing/allocation objectives; durable total/tails remain explicit.
- [ ] Activated preparation/grouping meets its own objective and finite queue/ownership/ACK gates; rejected mechanism history remains visible.
- [ ] Checkpoint allocation amplification is causally assigned and eliminated or explicitly minimized/accepted with alternatives and budget; no unexplained blocking residual.
- [ ] Revision scan/step/fence scaling meets bounded-work targets; storage/active append debt is demonstrated through meaningful rollover and pin drain with no unsafe reclaim.
- [ ] All semantic/correctness/lifetime/recovery guardrails pass; material tradeoffs have explicit acceptance and required public docs/examples reflect landed behavior.
- [ ] Raw packets, source/schema manifests and original binaries are durable and independently restorable/validatable; report and parent gate ledger name exact acceptance source.

If any north-star is inconclusive or fails, keep it open and return the attributed limiter to its sole owner or create a narrow blocking successor; an evidence PR cannot waive the product goal. An explicitly accepted narrower endpoint must be labelled separately.

Test-first exception: artifact/report-only PR has no production runtime change. Validate all landed validators, hashes, semantic receipts, independent restoration and links; do not invent runtime tests. Follow isolated topic PR, current-head CI and mature review policy. Supporting report belongs under `TreeDB/docs/evidence/r1-row-execution-architecture/`, with matching guide/example links and the parent acceptance ledger.


## Required constructor gate — 2026-10-08

The activated runtime gates now include [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), which owns genuine constructor-time Pager/resident accounting, strict shared-loan admission and actual read/index/stable-token terminal lifetime. Consume its merged accepted exact source through #5093/#5094/#5108/#5095. Component normal/race checks and source-only packets do not satisfy whole finite-budget, platform, durability, default-rollover or public performance acceptance. The original quantitative gates remain unchanged.
